title: Spin Down
description: Day 212 of the long leg. A vibration LEDGER calls "within limits" sends Priya on her first real EVA, and the Loire's commander on a decision about who she trusts.
scenario: Day 212 of the Loire's long leg home. The vehicle is at aphelion, Earth is twenty minutes away by radio, and a new four-hertz vibration has appeared in the slip-ring bearing that joins the Wheel to the Hub. Priya Venkataraman, the crew's newest member, has found it; now she has to convince a commander who distrusts software, a botanist who will have to despin his Garden, and herself.
